accepted: registered action ref and exact notification scope bind a typed command
fresh revision/digest/criteria/authority epoch/source cursor reaches ControlPlane admission
one admitted action ref is consumed once and records applied/failed/unknown separately from delivery ACK
the decision wakes exactly one registered wait key, and replays wake none
denied: stale target revision, digest or criteria revision
wrong decider/recipient, expired or non-authoritative action ref
scope widening, unknown action, raw secret payload or duplicate idempotency
double consume of one action ref and ambiguous wait keys
read/ACK changing HumanTask status or direct Broker effect
delivery ACK or read state presenting itself as an applied decision
